stem.en: Chennai receives 128.6 cm of rain in a year. Of this, 30.6 cm falls in October and 35.0 cm in November. What percentage of the year's rain falls in these two months? (Answer to the nearest whole per cent.)

explanation.en: October and November give 30.6 + 35.0 = 65.6 cm. Then 65.6 divided by 128.6 and multiplied by 100 gives about 51 per cent, just over half the year's rain.
